reference.title: VPN Resources and Support
reference.shortdesc: VPN FAQs, troubleshooting guides, acceptable use policies, and additional support documentation for VPN users.

section.title: NC State VPN Documentation and Guides
section.p: The NC State Office of Information Technology (OIT) maintains the following knowledge base guides and reference documentation for Cisco Secure Client users on the NC State VPN Overview (KB0021969) portal:

ul.li: VPN Client Network Overview: Explains how NC State routes remote traffic and protects access to internal campus systems.
NC State VPN FAQ: Answers common questions about mandatory Duo 2FA authentication, split tunneling, Internet2 access, and supported IP tunneling protocols.
VPN Client Troubleshooting: Provides fixes for common connection issues, including resolving unsuccessful domain name resolution errors and macOS connection service issues.
Start Before Logon: Instructions for authenticating to the NC State VPN prior to Windows logon on university-managed computers.

section.title: Acceptable Use Policies and Help Desk Support

ul.li: University Policies: All VPN users must comply with NC State's Use of IT Resources Policy and VPN Acceptable Use Policy.
NC State OIT Help Desk: For installation assistance, Duo bypass codes, or VPN troubleshooting, call 919-515-4357 (HELP) or submit a support request at help.ncsu.edu.
